# The Wreck of the Saltgrace

*In the Bellcaves under Bain Harbour's south cliff, the wreck of the Saltgrace lies wedged and tilted, her decks sloping down into dark water, overrun this spring with crabs, eels and worse. Its creatures meet you at your own level.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Levels | 20-70 |
| Town | [Bain Harbour](../towns/bain_harbour.md) |
